speaker: Wren
text: Easy. Sit if you can. The square's still here, and so are you. That's more than I expected from today.

speaker: Wren
text: Pell. Your lanterns are still hanging. Somebody has to light them. I'd offer, but I'd only set the wrong thing on fire.

speaker: Wren
text: Dova, your stall's right where you left it. Dusty. A little crooked. Like the rest of us, really.

speaker: Wren
text: Hask. The bell hasn't rung in a long while. You don't have to ring it yet. It can wait one more quiet hour.

speaker: Wren
text: Tamsin, you're listening to something I can't hear. If it gets loud, tell me. I'll stand between you and it. Badly, but I'll stand.

speaker: Wren
text: You were shell on one side and spark on the other. Now you're one thing again. Take your time getting used to it.
